inputs.name: ssh_allow
inputs.description: Ports sshd listens on, which stay open before the firewall turns on, such as ["22/tcp"]. When null, the ports Conn3x logs in on. Set it when a port forward or NAT sits between Conn3x and the hosts.

inputs.name: allow
inputs.description: Ports to open, each with its protocol, such as { port = "443/tcp" }, or { port = "5432/tcp", from = "10.0.0.0/8" } to open it to one address or network only.
